name: Rende (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rende (a castle on light blue in a yellow cartouche) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Rende, a comune in Calabria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Rende arms — castle on light blue in a yellow cartouche, crowned, within branches
